version.note: Version pin at retrieval time: date + manifest database_count. manifest_sha256 is the local-clone hash; the live manifest is marginally older/smaller (see STEP-0-1-VERIFICATION.md), so the count + date are the stable pin, the hash is the clone check.

record.body:
This closing record indexes the Signature biophony-soundscapes edition and points forward. The Signature edition holds sixteen records: a soundscape primer, forest, ocean, desert wind, wetland, quiet city, rainforest dawn, ice, savanna, river, night, seasonal shift, storm, coast, and restored quiet park models, and this index. Every record is labelled Signature in its title and body, every rendered sound is labelled SIMULATED, and no Signature record is presented as a recording of a real place. The companion Signature biofonics edition covers virtual voices and call designs, and the existing live pairs on animal sounds, whale song archives, and adaptive soundscape composition are cross-linked from here, never rebuilt. Future Signature waves, listed here as planned and not as delivered, include a Signature mountain-soundscapes set, a Signature island-soundscapes set, and a Signature cave-soundscapes set.

Science proof

Science proof: an index is verified by checking it against the records it lists. Every title named in this record appears in this edition with the stated layer coverage, ladder rank, and demo, and every cross-link named points to an existing live pair or to the companion pair in this suite. The index makes no claim about unbuilt waves beyond listing them as planned, so its claims are checkable from the package itself.

Math proof

Math proof: this edition holds 16 records, split into 6 simple, 5 compounded, and 5 complex records, since 6 + 5 + 5 = 16, and the whole suite holds 4 editions x 16 = 64 records. The demo prints counts 6, 5, 5, total 16, suite total 64, and the Signature editions' share of the suite, 32 / 64 = 50.0 percent.

Soundscape layer(s)

biophony; geophony; anthrophony

Source

Signature suite plan for this pair, October 2026; record contents of this edition as built

demo.code:
print('Simple records: %d' % 6)
print('Compounded records: %d' % 5)
print('Complex records: %d' % 5)
print('Total records: %d' % (6 + 5 + 5))
print('Suite total: %d records' % (4 * 16))
print('Signature editions share: %.1f percent' % (100.0 * 32 / 64))
demo.expected_output:
Simple records: 6
Compounded records: 5
Complex records: 5
Total records: 16
Suite total: 64 records
Signature editions share: 50.0 percent
